rationale: The original thesis remains intact as PINS continues to trade below both the declining 5-minute 9-EMA ($18.72) and session VWAP ($18.86) while broader market weakness intensifies (SPY down 0.97%, VIXY up 5.45%). Although price has bounced slightly from a recent low of $18.48 to $18.62, bounce volume on the 1-minute chart is relatively low compared to the initial drop, suggesting a minor pause rather than a reversal. Holding gives the position room to test the $18.20 target while the 5-minute 9-EMA and $18.96 invalidation level provide defined overhead resistance.
